theorems.name: encode_message_no_raw_brackets
theorems.doc: **S (U1 fix).** No byte of the message is copied into the frame as a raw `<` or `>`: every `<` in the encoding starts one of upstream's umlaut tokens `<U..>`, and every `>` ends one. So a message cannot close the frame (`<E>`) or open another command.
theorems.statement:
theorem encode_message_no_raw_brackets (msg out out' : Slice Std.U8) (n : Std.Usize)
    (h : encode_message msg out = ok (some n, out')) :
    ∀ k, k < n.val → out'.val[k]! = 60#u8 →
      out'.val[k + 1]! = 85#u8 ∧ out'.val[k + 4]! = 62#u8
theorems.proof:
theorem encode_message_no_raw_brackets (msg out out' : Slice Std.U8) (n : Std.Usize)
    (h : encode_message msg out = ok (some n, out')) :
    ∀ k, k < n.val → out'.val[k]! = 60#u8 →
      out'.val[k + 1]! = 85#u8 ∧ out'.val[k + 4]! = 62#u8 := by
  have hs := encode_message_loop_spec msg out 0#usize 0#usize (by simp) (by simp)
    (fun k hk => absurd hk (by simp))
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hp⟩ := (WP.spec_equiv_exists _ _).1 hs
  unfold encode_message at h
  rw [hr] at h
  simp only [Result.ok.injEq] at h
  subst h
  intro k hk h60
  exact ((hp n rfl).2 k hk h60).2

theorems.name: encode_message_total
theorems.statement:
theorem encode_message_total (msg out : Slice Std.U8) :
    ∃ r, encode_message msg out = ok r
theorems.proof:
theorem encode_message_total (msg out : Slice Std.U8) :
    ∃ r, encode_message msg out = ok r := by
  have hs := encode_message_loop_spec msg out 0#usize 0#usize (by simp) (by simp)
    (fun k hk => absurd hk (by simp))
  obtain ⟨r, hr, _⟩ := (WP.spec_equiv_exists _ _).1 hs
  exact ⟨r, hr⟩

theorems.name: pages_valid_only_ids
theorems.doc: **S (U1 fix).** An accepted schedule page list holds page IDs only.
theorems.statement:
theorem pages_valid_only_ids (pages : Slice Std.U8)
    (h : pages_valid pages = ok true) :
    ∀ k, k < pages.val.length → 65 ≤ (pages.val[k]!).val ∧ (pages.val[k]!).val ≤ 90
theorems.proof:
theorem pages_valid_only_ids (pages : Slice Std.U8)
    (h : pages_valid pages = ok true) :
    ∀ k, k < pages.val.length → 65 ≤ (pages.val[k]!).val ∧ (pages.val[k]!).val ≤ 90 := by
  have hs := pages_valid_loop_spec pages 0#usize (by simp)
  unfold pages_valid at h
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hp⟩ := (WP.spec_equiv_exists _ _).1 hs
  rw [hr] at h
  simp only [Result.ok.injEq] at h
  intro k hk
  exact hp h k (by simp) hk

theorems.name: page_id_valid_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem page_id_valid_iff (id : Std.U32) :
    page_id_valid id = ok (decide (65 ≤ id.val ∧ id.val ≤ 90))
theorems.proof:
theorem page_id_valid_iff (id : Std.U32) :
    page_id_valid id = ok (decide (65 ≤ id.val ∧ id.val ≤ 90)) := by
  unfold page_id_valid CAP_A CAP_Z
  first
    | (simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok]; split <;> simp_all <;> scalar_tac)
    | (simp [lift]; split <;> simp_all <;> omega)
    | (simp [lift, UScalar.cast_val_eq]; by_cases h1 : 65 ≤ id.val <;> simp_all <;> omega)

theorems.name: date_time_two_digits
theorems.doc: **S (U2 fix).** An accepted date/time has every field ≤ 99, so each `{:02}` field is two digits and the frame keeps its fixed width.
theorems.statement:
theorem date_time_two_digits (y w mo d h mi s : Std.U8)
    (hv : date_time_valid y w mo d h mi s = ok true) :
    y.val ≤ 99 ∧ w.val ≤ 99 ∧ mo.val ≤ 99 ∧ d.val ≤ 99 ∧ h.val ≤ 99 ∧ mi.val ≤ 99 ∧ s.val ≤ 99
theorems.proof:
theorem date_time_two_digits (y w mo d h mi s : Std.U8)
    (hv : date_time_valid y w mo d h mi s = ok true) :
    y.val ≤ 99 ∧ w.val ≤ 99 ∧ mo.val ≤ 99 ∧ d.val ≤ 99 ∧ h.val ≤ 99 ∧ mi.val ≤ 99 ∧ s.val ≤ 99 := by
  unfold date_time_valid two_digits at hv
  simp at hv
  split_ifs at hv <;> simp_all

theorems.name: ota_proceeds_only_with_a_length
theorems.doc: **S.** The flash is only touched for an octet-stream upload with a declared, non-zero length.
theorems.statement:
theorem ota_proceeds_only_with_a_length (o : Bool) (n : Std.Usize) (te : Bool)
    (h : ota_start o n te = ok OtaStart.Proceed) : o = true ∧ 0 < n.val
theorems.proof:
theorem ota_proceeds_only_with_a_length (o : Bool) (n : Std.Usize) (te : Bool)
    (h : ota_start o n te = ok OtaStart.Proceed) : o = true ∧ 0 < n.val := by
  unfold ota_start at h
  cases o <;> simp at h
  by_cases hn : n = 0#usize <;> simp_all
  · cases te <;> simp at h
  · scalar_tac

theorems.name: ota_complete_iff
theorems.doc: **S.** An image counts as complete exactly when every declared byte was written and nothing is left over.
theorems.statement:
theorem ota_complete_iff (w n r : Std.Usize) :
    ota_complete w n r = ok (decide (r.val = 0 ∧ w.val = n.val))
theorems.proof:
theorem ota_complete_iff (w n r : Std.Usize) :
    ota_complete w n r = ok (decide (r.val = 0 ∧ w.val = n.val)) := by
  unfold ota_complete
  by_cases h1 : r = 0#usize <;> by_cases h2 : w = n <;> simp_all <;> scalar_tac

theorems.name: waiting_time_letter
theorems.doc: **S (U3 fix).** An admitted waiting time prints as 'A'..='Z' (`value + 65 ≤ 90`, no wrap).
theorems.statement:
theorem waiting_time_letter (v : Std.U8) (h : waiting_time_valid v = ok true) :
    65 ≤ v.val + 65 ∧ v.val + 65 ≤ 90
theorems.proof:
theorem waiting_time_letter (v : Std.U8) (h : waiting_time_valid v = ok true) :
    65 ≤ v.val + 65 ∧ v.val + 65 ≤ 90 := by
  unfold waiting_time_valid WAITING_TIME_MAX at h
  simp at h
  scalar_tac

two_digits.lean:
def two_digits (v : Std.U8) : Result Bool := do
  ok (v <= 99#u8)
two_digits.upstream_note: upstream has no check (U2); guards the {:02} fields of DateTime and ScheduleDateTime

ota_start.lean:
def ota_start
  (octet_stream : Bool) (content_length : Std.Usize) (transfer_encoding : Bool)
  :
  Result OtaStart
  := do
  if octet_stream
  then
    if content_length = 0#usize
    then if transfer_encoding
         then ok OtaStart.Chunked
         else ok OtaStart.Empty
    else ok OtaStart.Proceed
  else ok OtaStart.WrongContentType
ota_start.upstream_note: octet-stream media type, then content_length == 0 (chunked vs empty)

date_time_valid.kernel_code:
pub fn date_time_valid(year: u8, week: u8, month: u8, day: u8, hour: u8, minute: u8, second: u8) -> bool {
    two_digits(year)
        && two_digits(week)
        && two_digits(month)
        && two_digits(day)
        && two_digits(hour)
        && two_digits(minute)
        && two_digits(second)
}
date_time_valid.lean:
def date_time_valid
  (year : Std.U8) (week : Std.U8) (month : Std.U8) (day : Std.U8)
  (hour : Std.U8) (minute : Std.U8) (second : Std.U8) :
  Result Bool
  := do
  let b ← two_digits year
  if b
  then
    let b1 ← two_digits week
    if b1
    then
      let b2 ← two_digits month
      if b2
      then
        let b3 ← two_digits day
        if b3
        then
          let b4 ← two_digits hour
          if b4
          then
            let b5 ← two_digits minute
            if b5
            then two_digits second
            else ok false
          else ok false
        else ok false
      else ok false
    else ok false
  else ok false
date_time_valid.upstream_note: upstream has no check (U2); guards clock_router's DateTime, formatted <SC>{:02}x7

  let i ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 CAP_A)
  if id >= i

       ok (id <= i1)
  else ok false
